title: Understanding Host-Phage Interactions with Cryo-Electron Microscopy and Tomography, Mass Spectrometry and Whole Cell Kinetic Modeling
content: The study of host-phage interactions at a molecular level is vital for understanding the mechanisms of viral replication and pathogenesis. In this work, we introduce a platform that combines large-scale cultivation, phage purification, advanced imaging techniques and mass spectrometry for time resolved infection studies. Through this workflow, we have constructed the first full atomic model of our target cyanophage at 3.56 Å, revealing five distinct coaxial orientations of its tail fibers. Cryo-ET analysis further elucidates the process of viral attachment and infection, highlighting the interaction dynamics as viruses engage with host cell membranes and in combination with mass spectrometry revealed a previously unknown host receptor that interacts with the phage tail fiber.
